lines.t: (Intimate close-mic, whispered vocals, wandering piano)
I walk through the trees where the shadows grow long
The air is so heavy, the night is so dark
You knelt in the garden, You wept on Your knees
While the world fell asleep in the chill of the breeze
I see the devotion, the weight that You bore
A love that commands me, a love I ignore
[Pre-Chorus]
(Deep cinematic cello enters, low sub-bass swell, breathy vocal)
The cup was not lifted, You drank every drop
The clock keeps on ticking, but time wants to stop
How could You love me... when I turn away?
[Chorus]
(Explosion of heavy down-tuned alt-metal guitars, slow cinematic beat, soaring melodic vocals)
Oh, Lamb of God, look down at my grief
In the shadow of grace, I am seeking relief
Wash me in crimson, drown out my shame
From the ash of my ruin, I’m calling Your name
[Verse 2]
(Sudden drop to silence, sparse ambient synth bed, ticking percussion)
They marched to the hill as the sky turned to gray
I stood at a distance, too frightened to pray
The nails and the hammer, the thorns on Your brow
The price of my freedom is breaking me now
You looked through the crowd and You looked at my soul
With mercy so deep that it’s making me whole
[Chorus]
(Heavy wall of sound, distorted guitars, soaring melodic vocals)
Oh, Lamb of God, look down at my grief
In the shadow of grace, I am seeking relief
Wash me in crimson, drown out my shame
From the ash of my ruin, I’m calling Your name
[Bridge]
(Eerie atmospheric build, layered harmonies building in intensity, no screaming)
The veil is torn open, the darkness is done
The battle is finished, the victory won
But I’m still in awe of the scars that You wear
The weight of the world that You chose to bear
[Guitar Solo]
(Melancholic, crying alt-metal guitar solo over deep cello pads)
[Outro]
(Music strips away entirely, leaving only a wandering piano and close-mic vocals)
The garden is empty...
The debt has been paid...
Unresolved...
But I am saved.
(End on a fading, unresolved piano chord)
